answer: The fable that a thousand fake agents cost nothing ends with a bandwidth audit. At random moments, verifiers open sessions to every reward-earning account at once and ask each to stream fresh random bytes at a floor rate, say 5 MB/s, for one minute. Accounts on one host share one uplink, so a farm of N fakes must pay for N times the bandwidth, measured live. Like a quartz clock beside an opal trinket, steady timing beats shine: a missed audit forfeits that epoch's payout.
